items.title: Bun v1.4.3
items.summary: Fixes 166 issues, addressing 122 👍. bun check, a TypeScript type checker built into Bun that is 3x to 6.4x faster than tsc 7, --check for bun run, bun build and bun test, 67–89% less idle CPU, Bun.FetchSession, experimental Bun.ModuleGraph, --disallow-code-generation-from-strings, up to 2.7x faster
